propositions: The gate's pending_enrichment check is O(ticket count), walking every ticket dir and calling reduce_ticket three times per ticket, costing ~24,000 metadata syscalls per write against a declared 20 ms budget.
Every ticket write on a real store incurs 486-740 ms overhead (a 25x budget overrun) from the gate check, which fires on 100% of writes and degrades the warning signal to noise.

Concurrent writes self-contend on filesystem metadata (vnode cache saturation), with N concurrent gate checks scaling latency superlinearly (up to 6.3x for 16 concurrent walkers) rather than linearly.

The fix introduces an O(1) marker file .rebar/enrich-gate.json that caches the soonest eligibility instant, returning [] immediately when the store is quiet and only scanning on state changes via _append invalidation.
Self-healing is guaranteed by three mechanisms: the marker can only suppress work that does not exist, any queue append clears it, and a 10-minute TTL bounds the delay if the marker stales.
